annotations.title: Fence materials calculator (posts, concrete, rails, pickets)

description: Fence materials calculator (posts, concrete, rails, pickets) — Wood fence materials estimator. Required: length_ft (total fence line). Optional: height_ft (3-8, default 6), style (privacy | picket | board-on-board), post_spacing_ft (default 8), picket_width_in (default 5.5), gap_in, overlap_in (board-on-board, default 1), gates, gate_width_ft (default 4), corners, bag_lb (40 | 50 | 60 | 80, default 50). Returns sections, post count/size/stock length, hole depth and diameter (1/3 height + 6 in gravel), concrete bags per post and total, gravel, rails per section and count, pickets with 5% waste, fasteners, rail brackets, gate hardware and notes. Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: eng_fence
